project: Chronolyte AI Pet Shop Website Reel

audio.sound_design: original procedural UI taps and page-transition swishes

beats.headline: PET SHOP OWNERS / YOUR NEXT CUSTOMER IS SCROLLING.
beats.action: Open directly on a full-screen pet-shop website hero. No device frame: playful hero photo, full-width nav, kinetic hook type, floating paw/star doodles and visible shop button fill the vertical canvas.

beats.caption: GOOD STUFF FOR GOOD PETS.
beats.action: Slide to the full-screen home route. Scroll from the oversized headline and shop button into the pets photo, colorful dog/cat categories and a lively product strip.

beats.caption: TINY JOYS. BIG PERSONALITY.
beats.action: Open the shop page full-frame in saturated lilac. Oversized category tabs, illustrated paw/star accents and product cards sweep up; the pet-accessory flat-lay spans the page edge-to-edge.

beats.caption: THEIR NEW FAVORITE IS ONE TAP AWAY.
beats.action: A full-screen product detail route opens with a large cat-and-toy photo, color choices and a bold Add to Bag button. A cursor selects and taps; the bag count pops once.

beats.caption: FROM BROWSE TO BAG — SMOOTHLY.
beats.action: Open a full-screen shopping bag route. Show the selected toy, quantity control and a bright checkout CTA; animate the order summary into place without implying a real purchase.

beats.headline: WANT A WEBSITE THIS GOOD?
beats.action: Resolve into a full-screen Chronolyte AI end card, keeping www.chronolyteai.site and +1 (812) 690-6121 large, centered and together for more than three seconds.
